title: I’ll tickle his catastrophe,
html_source: In ‘II Henry IV’, the hostess, Fang (the sheriff’s sergeant), and his boy attempt to arrest Falstaff, who is accompanied by Page and Bardolph. Page threatens the hostess with his drawn sword: “Away, you scullion! You rampallian! You Fustilarian! I’ll tickle your catastrophe [buttocks]!”
